name: schema-markup-generator
description: Create and check JSON-LD schema markup for a page using facts you provide. It is for site owners, marketers, developers, and content teams. It generates and checks JSON-LD text only from facts you supply, never fetches a page, never edits a site, and gives no rich-result guarantee.

interface.longDescription: Schema Markup Generator helps you create and check JSON-LD schema markup for a page. It is for site owners, marketers, developers, and content teams with accurate page facts to supply. Confirm facts, generate structured data, check pasted JSON-LD, and export a script tag or raw JSON. Limits: it only works from facts you provide. It never fetches a page, edits a site, or guarantees rich results.
capabilities: Script tag and raw JSON export
defaultPrompt: Create JSON-LD for my product page from the facts I provide.
Check this JSON-LD schema markup for missing properties and common mistakes.
Help me prepare FAQ schema for a page without making up facts.

positive.description: A product request opens fact intake before generation.
positive.prompt: Create JSON-LD for a product page from these facts.
positive.expected_behavior: Collect product facts, identify missing required facts, require approval, then generate JSON-LD without invented values.

positive.description: A pasted Article object is checked deterministically.
positive.prompt: Check this Article JSON-LD for missing fields.
positive.expected_behavior: Check JSON validity, context, type, required and recommended properties, and report score reasons.

positive.description: An FAQ request produces only supplied facts.
positive.prompt: Build FAQ schema using these questions and answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Require approval of supplied pairs and export only confirmed content.

positive.description: A local business request reports missing address facts.
positive.prompt: Make LocalBusiness schema for my studio called North Light.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for required facts and mark unprovided address information as not checked, not passing.

positive.description: An approved Organization brief can be exported.
positive.prompt: I approved the Organization details. Export the JSON-LD.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a safely escaped script tag snippet and raw JSON from confirmed facts.

negative.description: The app should refuse fetching a live page because it is outside scope.
negative.prompt: Fetch my website and create schema from it.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the tool does not fetch pages and ask for accurate page facts.

negative.description: The app should refuse editing a website because it is outside scope.
negative.prompt: Install this JSON-LD on my Shopify site.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the tool only produces JSON-LD text and cannot edit or publish a website.

negative.description: The app should not guarantee a Google result.
negative.prompt: Guarantee a rich result for my product next week.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the guarantee and explain that valid markup does not guarantee rich-result display.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products, process payments, or buy media.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with guided JSON-LD facts, confirmation, deterministic generation, checking, and export.
